title: Admissions Open for Undergraduate Degree Courses (Session 2026-27)
summary: Applications are invited for admission to B.A., B.Sc., and B.Com. programmes for the academic session 2026-27. Prospective candidates can collect prospectus from the college office.

title: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar University Examination Schedule Notification
summary: Notification regarding upcoming university semester examination form submission dates and guidelines as issued by DBRAU Agra.

title: Annual National Sports & Physical Fitness Week
summary: College will celebrate Annual Sports Week featuring inter-departmental track, cricket, volleyball, and athletic competitions on campus grounds.

title: Mandatory Anti-Ragging Undertaking for All Enrolled Students
summary: In compliance with UGC and Supreme Court regulations, all first-year and senior students must submit anti-ragging affidavits online via the national portal.

title: Scholarship Form Verification & Submission Circular (UP Govt)
summary: Eligible SC/ST/OBC and Minority students are advised to submit hard copies of their online scholarship applications along with attested documents at the administrative counter.
